messages:
maya: Zoe (auditor) asked for KMS evidence for INC-2026-0510: key policy snapshot, CloudTrail Encrypt/Decrypt events, list-grants, and a signed manifest. Who can assemble?
evidence-bot: Playbook reminder: include exporter identity, file->sha256 manifest, presign creator + CloudTrail PutObject entry, control mapping (SOC2 CC6.2 / ISO27001 A.9.2.1).
liam: I can pull CloudTrail and KMS outputs. Do we also need k8s RoleBinding diffs tied to the same window?
auditor-zoe: Yes — include kube-audit excerpts and any RoleBinding changes. Prefer GraphML for access graph and CSV for quick mapping. Time window: 2026-04-10T03:00:00Z - 2026-04-10T07:00:00Z.
maya: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey & AssumeRole 2) describe-key + get-key-policy + list-grants 3) dump rolebindings and kube-audit 4) run iam_graph -> graphml 5) tar.gz + sha256 + detached GPG sig; upload with object-lock and record sts:GetCallerIdentity before presign.
infra-oncall: When uploading, set S3 Object Lock retention 30d and tag evidence:INC-2026-0510. Save CloudTrail S3 object keys in manifest.
liam: Commands I'll run (short):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-04-10T03:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-04-10T07:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/cc33dd44 > kms_describe.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/cc33dd44 > kms_grants.json
kubectl get rolebinding -n prod my-app -o yaml > my-app_rolebinding_after.yaml
python tools/iam_graph.py --keys key_arns.txt --output inc0510_access.graphml
```
maya: Include timeline.md correlating KMS usage to RoleBinding changes and pod events. Don't paste presigned URL here.
liam: Creating tarball and signature now, uploading to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0510/ with object-lock. Captured sts:GetCallerIdentity and saved as presign_identity.json.
auditor-zoe: Please ensure manifest.json includes: files[], exported_by, exported_at, presigned_creator, presign_created_at, control_map, time_window, and GPG key fingerprint.
liam: Manifest summary: files: ct_encrypt.json, kms_describe.json, kms_grants.json, my-app_rolebinding_after.yaml, kube-audit.json, inc0510_access.graphml, timeline.md, inc0510_evidence.tar.gz, inc0510.sha256, inc0510.sig; exported_by: liam@redwood.com; exported_at: 2026-04-10T09:12:00Z; presign_creator: liam@redwood.com; presign_created_at: 2026-04-10T09:13:00Z; control_map: ["SOC2 CC6.2","ISO27001 A.9.2.1"]; sha256 truncated: f3a9c2d...
auditor-zoe: Received package. I'll validate checksum + GPG sig and confirm if raw CloudTrail objects are needed for deeper forensic validation. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks team — I'll update the evidence tracker and mark INC-2026-0510/evidence-v1 as delivered.
